data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: river
sections.question: river
sections.summary: a large natural flow of fresh water that moves towards the sea or a lake

senses.definition: a large natural flow of fresh water that moves continuously in one direction towards the sea, a lake, or another river
examples: They swam in the river on hot summer afternoons.
The river flooded the fields after several days of heavy rain.

answers.answer: They swam in the river on hot summer afternoons.
She drank a bowl of hot river with bread for her lunch.
He drove his river to work every morning through the city traffic.
She planted a river in her garden and watered it every day.

sections.title: social media
sections.question: social media
sections.summary: websites and apps that allow people to share content and communicate with others online

senses.definition: websites and applications that allow people to create, share, and view content and to communicate and connect with other people online
examples: She uses social media to stay in touch with friends and family around the world.
He spends too much time on social media and does not read enough books.

answers.answer: She uses social media to stay in touch with friends and family around the world.
He cooked social media for dinner and served it to the whole family.
She planted social media in the garden to make it look more colourful.
He drove his social media to work every morning and parked it outside.

sections.title: tree
sections.question: tree
sections.summary: a tall plant with a thick wooden trunk, branches, and leaves that lives for many years

senses.definition: a tall plant with a thick wooden trunk, branches, and leaves that lives for many years and grows much taller than other plants
examples: The children climbed the old tree in the garden.
They planted a tree in the park to celebrate the new year.

answers.answer: The children climbed the old tree in the garden and sat in the branches.
She drank a hot tree every morning before going to school.
He drove his tree to work every day because the office was very far away.
She cooked a tree in the oven for Sunday dinner.
